name: Islanding Detection Guarded Activation
description: When the islanding detection flag b_island=1, protection relays must trip within 2 s to isolate the distributed generator. Guarded UPR: the trip command applies only when b_island=1.

elements.name: Islanding Detection Flag
elements.description: Binary flag: 0=grid connected (normal), 1=islanding detected by ROCOF or voltage relay.

uncertainty.source: IEEE 1547 anti-islanding protection: ROCOF or voltage/frequency relay detection

elements.name: Maximum Islanding Disconnect Time
elements.description: IEEE 1547: distributed generator must disconnect within 2 s of islanding detection

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(relay) = trip_command if b_island=1, else normal_operation; guard activates protection when islanding detected
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: protection trip applies only when islanding detection flag b_island=1 is active.
